question: Break that down by year.

priorTurns.question: How many units have we sold in total?
priorTurns.sql: SELECT SUM(ol.Quantity) AS UnitsSold FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol

referenceSql: SELECT cal.[Year], SUM(ol.Quantity) AS UnitsSold FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId JOIN dbo.Calendar AS cal ON cal.[Date] = o.OrderDate GROUP BY cal.[Year] ORDER BY cal.[Year]
